propositions: Reconcile passes with silently-failed sub-ops report exit 0 and 'converged' despite failures, making sync failures invisible
Partial comment failures recorded in comment_errors are not counted toward mutation_failures and do not trigger non-zero exit codes
The silent-no-op canary only hard-fails when RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP flag is explicitly set to 1 (default 0 = warn-only)
When the fail-loud flag is activated, outcomes containing comment_errors must be promoted to count toward mutation_failures and drive non-zero pass exit
The flag must remain gated (default OFF) until a preceding Jira comment cleanup completes, to avoid failing reconcile passes on capped tickets with unsynced comments
